notes: Same-origin, server-side. The browser calls GET /api/dashboard and GET /api/queue on console.novacaelum.com with its Cloudflare Access cookie; it never holds an ops, vault or GitHub token.

Every panel is independent: switch on panel.status. 'ok' = data fields are valid. 'error' = the source failed (panel.error is an error TYPE name only, never text). 'unavailable' = no cloud source exists for it yet (panel.reason says why). A failed panel never fails the response.
Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings. Format to ET in the UI.
Completing a queue row = POST /api/queue/complete {id}. Daniel's own rows only; it writes state=done and nothing else.
Cache-Control is private, no-store. Poll no faster than every 30 s.

GET /api/queue extra errors: 503 {error:'not_configured', secret: NAME}, 502 {error: '<source>_denied'|'<source>_unreachable'|...}. Errors for the whole request: 401 {error:'no_access_token'|'invalid_access_token'}, 403 {error:'not_allowed'}, 500 {error:'misconfigured', missing:[names]}. 405 for non-GET.

endpoints.GET /api/queue: Queue (below). Open Task Graph rows with assignee_agent = daniel, full description. Example under examples.queue.
endpoints.POST /api/queue/complete: Body {id: external_id of a queue row}. Marks the row done through the console's existing done path (state=done, completed_by caelos-console). 200 {ok:true,id,state:'done',already_done:boolean}. Errors: 400 bad_request, 403 not_your_row (assignee is not daniel), 404 row_not_found, 409 row_not_open (e.g. deferred/archived), 502 ops_http_<status>|ops_unreachable, 503 not_configured. Plus the whole-request errors below. Refetch GET /api/queue afterwards.

panels.waiting_on_daniel: { status, count: number (prs.total + queue_rows.length), prs: PrGroups | {status:'error'|'unavailable'}, queue_status: PanelStatus (status of the Task Graph half; prs carries its own), queue_rows: QueueRowSummary[], rows_to_decide: { status:'unavailable', reason } }
panels.queue: { status, count: number, by_state: { [state]: number } }  (QueueRowSummary list lives in waiting_on_daniel.queue_rows; GET /api/queue has the full rows)
panels.next_priority: { status, note: string | null, items: { depth: number, text: string }[] }  (Daniel's own words, tab nesting as depth; render as a numbered outline)
panels.crazy_list: { status, count: number, entries: { name: string, area: string, added: string, note: string, source: string }[] }  (open entries only)
panels.workstream: { status, live: boolean, slug: string | null, orchestrator: string | null, deadline: ISO | null, seconds_left: number | null, agents: { name, used: number | null, budget: number | null, rows: string[], state: string | null, note: string | null }[] }
panels.loops: { status, count: number, items: { goal: string, status: string, node: string | null, folder: string }[] }  (live first, then others by goal; 'live' means Daniel's test is owed)
panels.open_work: { status, total: number, truncated: boolean, by_state: { [state]: number }, by_project: { project: string, count: number }[], in_progress: { short_id, name, project, assignee: string | null, updated_at: ISO, link: string | null }[] }
panels.open_prs: { status, total: number, truncated: boolean, items: { repo, number, title, url, author: string | null, draft: boolean, opened: ISO, escalated: boolean }[] }  (every open PR in the Nova-Caelum org)
panels.verifier_closes: { status, items: { row: string (project:slug), project: string, at: ISO, run_id: string | null, work_item_id: string | null, link: string | null }[] }  (latest 10, author tg_verifier)
panels.runtime_deploys: { status, current: boolean | null (null = cannot tell), installed_sha: string | null, origin_main_sha: string | null, items: { at: ISO, author: string, summary: string }[] }  (latest 5, tag runtime-deploy; installed_sha parsed from 'origin/main <sha>' in the summary)
panels.ci: { status, checked: number (repos), red: { repo, workflow: string, url: string | null }[] }

types.PrGroups: { status:'ok', total: number, groups: { repo, items: { number, title, url, opened: ISO }[] }[], repins: { repo, number, url }[] }  (label escalate-daniel; 'devops-lead reviewer: re-pin' PRs are collapsed into repins)
types.QueueRowSummary: { id: external_id, short_id: string | null, project: string, name: string, state: 'pending-review'|'ready'|'in-progress'|'blocked', type: string, effort_level: string | null, updated_at: ISO, link: string | null (null for legacy rows with no project; project is then '') }
types.QueueRow: QueueRowSummary + { created_at: ISO, description: string (Go / look / send live here), acceptance_criteria: string | null, source_references: { uri, anchor? }[], team: string[] }
